set.approach: Follow the Lion's Head approach: park at the hairpin on the state forest road above Priest Lake and take the flagged climber's trail to the talus field below the peak. Circle of Life climbs a line of cracks on the north face, starting to the right of Lion Tamer; a tree in a slot at the base of the third pitch is a good landmark.
set.descent_text: Rappel the route back to the base. The second pitch is long and needs a second rope; the remaining pitches can be rappelled on a single rope.

review.notes: Route page: start and descent; area pages: access. Rope lengths left out.

set.approach: Follow the Lion's Head approach: park at the hairpin on the state forest road above Priest Lake and take the flagged climber's trail to the talus field below the peak. Elephant Graveyard splits the middle of the north face as a wall-style line, in shade most of the day.
set.descent_text: Rappelling the route is the best way down; the rappels use double ropes, stopping at the triangular tower at the base of the fifth pitch and at the bolts passed halfway up the first pitch.

review.notes: Route page for line and descent; area for access. Rappel counts left out.

set.approach: Follow the Lion's Head approach: park at the hairpin on the state forest road above Priest Lake and take the flagged climber's trail to the talus field below the peak. Rafiki's Wisdom follows the principal left-facing corner system up the centre of the north face, beginning in the big corner under the conspicuous roof.
set.descent_text: With a full wall kit, rappel the route, using a long double-rope rappel to the top of the second pitch. The other option is to walk across the summit area to the usual rappel stations on Lion's Head's southeast side.

review.notes: Route page for start and descent; area for access.
